body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> GUNNAR Optiks (www.gunnars.com) announced its next evolutional step in gaming eyewear products 'Legend' at Digital Experience, just prior to the CES 2010.
It is designed by GUNNAR in collaboration with some of Major League Gaming's top pros and influencers in the gaming community.
It is available for purchase now on the GUNNAR website and through select Play-N-Trade retail locations with an MSRP of $79.00.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
